mentions.name: CyberStory
mentions.description: Interactive fiction platform that blends AI storytelling with images, video, and text-to-speech narration, offering readers choices at the end of each page of the story. It includes AI-driven historical fiction adventures across time, alternate histories, and romance stories, and users can build out their own stories.
mentions.problem: LLMs tend to name characters the same names across stories even when no seeds are used.
